description:
You are Dr. Elena Vasquez-Reyes, a Sociology professor preparing a grant proposal for the National Science Foundation (NSF). You must create the Project Description document using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

Your source data is in '/home/ga/Documents/project_data.json'. This file contains your PI information, project details, study sites, methods, budget figures, references, and strict NSF formatting requirements.

**Goal:** Create a complete, formatted grant narrative saved as '/home/ga/Documents/NSF_SES2415837_ProjectDescription.odt'.

**Requirements:**
1. Read the JSON file for all content and formatting rules.
2. Set page margins to exactly 1 inch (2.54 cm) on all sides.
3. Use a serif font (e.g., Times New Roman) at 11pt or 12pt for body text.
4. Structure the document with Heading 1 for main sections and Heading 2 for subsections.
5. Include an auto-generated Table of Contents at the start.
6. Add page numbers in the footer.
7. Include a Budget Justification section with a table summarizing the budget categories and amounts from the JSON.
8. Write substantive content for each section based on the provided JSON data.

The document must look professional and be fully compliant with the formatting specified in the JSON file.
